comparison.objective: Form a specified cable drip loop before a gland, versus tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible-cable routing, hook placement, and shape control, not rigid tool use or impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Loop low point must be 3–7 cm below gland center and remain after release; cable-strain and gland-load limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests persistent deformable routing geometry, not shock-absorber commissioning.
